description: Search the complete program catalog, including digital nomad, retirement, investor, residency-to-PR and citizenship pathways. Returns compact canonical rows with program_ids for get_program. Use query for names or concepts such as "property investment", "pension", "naturalization" or "remote work".

country.description: Country name or slug, e.g. "Panama" or "costa-rica".

limit.description: How many matching programs to return. Defaults to 25; count gives the total.

program_type.description: Only this program category. Defaults to "any".

query.description: Optional words to find across program names and details, e.g. "property investment", "pension" or "naturalization".

name: search_programs
title: Search immigration programs
